definitions.explanation: The pattern of lines on the surface of cut wood, made by the tree's growth rings and fibers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{木目|もくめ}。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{木目|もくめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦きれい→きれい：00717_kirei⟧だ。
examples.english: This table has a lovely grain.

examples.japanese: {木目|もくめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}ら→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{透明|とうめい}→透明：04565_toumei⟧な⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げた→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧。
examples.english: To bring out the grain, we finished it with only a clear coat instead of paint.

notes:
Also read きめ, but in modern use きめ ("texture") is usually written {肌理|きめ}, as in ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧きめ (skin texture). {木目|もくめ} names the grain only. As a modifier, {木目調|もくめちょう} means "wood-grain finish" on furniture or flooring made to look like wood.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {木目|もくめ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{生|い}かす: to bring out the grain
- {木目|もくめ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: the grain is beautiful
- {木目調|もくめちょう}: wood-grain finish
- {木目|もくめ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{沿|そ}って→沿う：13279_sou⟧: along the grain
